name: Fernwood Cannabis Co.
description: A sample adult-use dispensary in Denver: license, owner credential and sales rules, store details, a front-counter register and a twelve-item menu received, lab-passed and released. License, credential, lab and manifest details are fictional sample records; replace them with your own before selling.

authority.citations: 1 CCR 212-3 Colorado retail marijuana rules (sample citation)
authority.returnPolicy: Unopened or defective products within 7 days with the receipt. Returned product is quarantined and never resold.
authority.outagePolicy: Stop regulated sales while the point of sale or the traceability system is down, and record the outage as an incident.
authority.privacyPolicy: ID is checked at the counter. We keep only what state rules require, and never sell customer details.
authority.retentionPolicy: Sales, inventory, cash and incident records are kept for at least three years.
